visual_text: The family carer needs a handover of their own
Illustration, not a real case. Discharge plans that included carers: about a quarter fewer readmissions over 3 to 6 months (relative; multi-part programmes)
Ask what the carer is willing and able to do
Show the task, then watch the carer show it back
Link the carer to community services
Say who to call with questions
Steps 2 to 4 echo components used in some of the tested programmes. Steps 1 and 5 are our suggestions.
Rodakowski et al., J Am Geriatr Soc, 2017
alt_text: Illustration, not a real case. A hospital discharge bay: an older man seated beside his walking frame, a nurse kneeling to show the daughter how to help him, and the daughter holding a folder. Five numbered steps for a carer handover. Discharge plans that included carers: about a quarter fewer readmissions at 3 to 6 months.
